Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.Utility
Class.Description: Utility for Interface specific HDD webservice

Method.name: AddUniqueChildObject
Method.Implementation: set newHddObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.HddObject).%New() set newHddObj.NCID = objNcid set newHddObj.Index = index Do reqObj.listOfHddNcidObj.Insert(newHddObj) Quit $$$OK

Method.name: CreateUniqueChildObject
Method.Implementation: set reqObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.UniqueChildLookupRequest).%New() set reqObj.listOfHddNcidObj = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() return reqObj
